about: O13: the engine sends its meters to core.vu-relay; Core forwards the datagram, bytes unchanged, to each display the analyzer used to reach -- the truth's core routes that carry vu: Motion's vu port, the mixer, radla -- once each. StemDeck's meters (41-50) go to nobody here: no remote Motion or desk is followed. HAND-WRITTEN expected: B1 has no such path (see README, Hand-written expectations). Runs on the engine truth (a3-core 78230b9), not B1's.
